description: This file defines a QuestionGeneratorAgent class that uses a state machine workflow to generate questions for a medical exam prep application. It includes methods for single and batch question generation, with validation and conditional logic, and references external modules for graph management, logging, and configuration.

classes.name: QuestionState
classes.description: TypedDict schema representing the state of the question generation workflow

classes.name: QuestionGeneratorAgent
classes.description: Agent class that manages question generation workflow using a state graph, including methods for single and batch question creation with validation logic

methods.description: Constructs the state graph workflow for question generation

methods.name: _should_regenerate
methods.description: Decision function to determine if question generation should be retried based on validation results

methods.name: generate_single_question
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a single validated question for a given chapter and difficulty

methods.name: generate_batch_questions
methods.description: Asynchronously generates multiple questions in batches, with concurrency control
